reason: An image-generation router for DeepSeek Harness that discovers or configures image models from OpenAI-compatible providers, exposes agent tools and REST endpoints, and returns generated images.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的图像生成路由，可配置兼容 OpenAI 接口的服务并在对话或 REST API 中生成图片。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness image-generation router that configures OpenAI-compatible providers and generates images through agent tools or a REST API.

capabilities: Calls configured external image-generation APIs over HTTP
Accepts and persists provider API keys in configuration
Exposes REST endpoints for source management and image generation
Registers agent tools for image generation and source listing
